title: Sono-Tek Completes Senior Management Transition
summary: Welcome to our new Executive Chairman and our new CEO! Familiar faces, new roles. January 2, 2024 we announced that Dr. Christopher Coccio is now Sono-Tek’s Executive Chairman and Stephen Harshbarger has been appointed as CEO. See the full press release here: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2024/01/02/2802640/0/en/Sono-Tek-Completes-Senior-Management-Transition.html
